name: v1.5.1
body:
What's new in 1.5.1 (with everything from 1.5.0):

- **Liquid Glass theme**: the accent colour at full strength as a wallpaper of 3D ribbons, with clear frosted glass panels, bright rims, glass cards, buttons and switches. Dialogs frost properly.
- **Windows updates install**: the installer runs silently, the app restarts by itself, and a log is kept in %TEMP%. Update notes show only what changed. Copies installed in Program Files update too (Windows asks for permission).
- **Library scans and thumbnails no longer get stuck** on slower PCs or when the Glass theme is on.
- **Player**: compact top and bottom bars, no square shadow under the centre button, drag the window by the top bar or the video, subtitle files next to a video are shown, Open file plays the rest of the folder, screenshots are named after the video and time.
- **Library**: counts update after a scan, songs are counted apart from videos, short libraries show minutes.

> **Windows:** versions before this one could not finish an update by themselves. Install this version once from the files below; after that, updates install from inside the app.
